desc:
🚨 Secure the jail! Stop riots. Prevent escapes.

🔍 Search inmates and visitors for contraband
🔑 Lock down dangerous cell blocks
📦 Confiscate illegal weapons and forbidden items
💰 Earn cash and upgrade your security equipment
⚠️ Stop riots, escapes, and dangerous inmates!

🔥 The longer you survive, the more violent and unpredictable the prison becomes.

⚔️ Defeat the final threat and restore order to the prison
🏆 Unlock exclusive rewards and achievements

📱 Playable on Desktop, Mobile, Tablet & Console

🚔 Do you have what it takes to become the ultimate Prison Warden?
